lines.en: Hi, I need a ticket that costs less than the regular one.

lines.en: We have a discount ticket that is cheaper after nine o’clock.

lines.en: Is there a monthly pass that costs less than daily tickets?

lines.en: Yes, a monthly pass that costs forty dollars is cheaper than single tickets.

facts.label: Relativa + comparativo
facts.sub: Use that + verbo e than para comparar: a ticket that costs less than the regular one.

facts.label: que + verbo
facts.sub: Use that + verbo para descrever uma coisa: a ticket that costs less, a card that shows your photo. Depois de that vem o verbo, sem repetir o sujeito.

facts.label: mais barato que
facts.sub: Use adjetivo curto + -er + than para comparar: A monthly pass is cheaper than single tickets. Para adjetivos longos, use more: more expensive than.
